# Renovatio — full LLM context

Renovatio is a free, bilingual progressive web app for people who want to rebuild small moments of pleasure and motivation through behavioral activation. The app is available in English (en-US) and Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).

## Product summary

- Name: Renovatio
- Type: Progressive Web App (PWA)
- Default documentation language: English
- Languages: English (US) and Portuguese (Brazil)
- URL: https://claudiobzrr.github.io/renovatio/
- Repository: https://github.com/ClaudioBzrr/renovatio
- Category: Health and lifestyle support tool
- Price: Free
- Account required: No
- Cloud or analytics: No
- Offline: Yes, after the first visit

## Core workflow

1. The user creates one to three micro-tasks with a time and selected weekdays.
2. Before a task, the app offers a two-minute anticipation exercise.
3. During a task, it offers a one-minute sensory pause.
4. To complete a task, the user must write what was minimally good about it. This is the anti-damping reflection.
5. Separately, the user has a daily goal of three good gestures: kindness, connection and accomplishment. Each gesture must be reported.
6. The app stores reflections, good gestures and history locally and displays a heatmap.

## Privacy and backups

All records stay in the browser's localStorage (`renovatio.data.v1`). Reminder scheduling metadata stays in the service worker's IndexedDB. There is no account, server, cloud sync or analytics. Encrypted backups use AES-256-GCM with a key derived from the user's password using PBKDF2-SHA-256 and 310,000 iterations. The password is never stored or transmitted. An encrypted backup can be imported only with the same password; lost passwords cannot be recovered. The app migrates data from the legacy `brasa.data.v1` key when present.

## Notifications

The app asks for browser notification permission through a user action. It uses a service worker to schedule local reminders and an in-app reminder engine while open. Exact delivery with the app fully closed is not guaranteed without a Web Push server. Some operating systems suspend service workers or delay background notifications. Installing the PWA and opening it periodically improves reliability.

## Method and safety

The method is inspired by the video “É por isso que você não sente prazer em nada (e como voltar a sentir)” from the Saúde da Mente channel. The app is independent and not affiliated with the channel. Renovatio is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat anhedonia, depression or any other condition. It does not replace psychotherapy, medical assessment, medication or emergency support. In a crisis, call 188 (CVV, Brazil, 24h) or 192 (SAMU).
